title: Inventory
description: The church's equipment: status, maintenance and a QR label.
search: Search by name, code, brand or serial

scan.title: Scan a label
scan.hint: Point the camera at the item's QR label.
scan.cameraError: We couldn't open the camera. Check the browser permission or use your phone's camera.
scan.notInventory: That QR code isn't an inventory label.

qr.title: Label
qr.hint: With a phone camera, the QR opens this page. It only works for people with access to the inventory.
qr.notFound: This label doesn't match any item in your church, or you don't have access to the inventory.

deleteBody: It disappears from the inventory and its label stops working. If it's no longer used but you want to keep it, mark it as “Retired”.

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Leave it empty and we'll generate one (EQ-0001).
form.codeInvalid: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (up to 20).

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.statusAfterHint: Update the status if it changed (for example, it works again).
maintenance.deleteBody: It's removed from the item's history.
